stem: Aarav's class needs $47$ chairs. Chairs are sold only in packs of $10$.

parts.text: Which claim correctly states what kind of number the order requires?

options.text: Order exactly $47$ chairs, because every count must stay exact.
Round down to $40$, because a smaller order is always safer.
Round up to $50$, because packs of $10$ must cover all $47$ seats.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Packs cannot be split, so the order must be the least multiple of $10$ that is at least $47$, which is rounding up to $50$.

teacher.key_rationale: Buying whole packs to cover a need requires rounding up. Exact 47 is impossible by pack size; rounding down leaves seats short.
